source_review: Original MiniDFSCluster JUnit TestSnapshot#testSnapshot reaches the addSnapshot quota guard on its false arm: 20 iterations create two unique snapshots each under quota 65536, at most 20 per directory. SnapshotTestHelper.createSnapshot also calls allowSnapshot before every creation, restoring the default quota. No original HDFS test sets a small positive snapshotQuota or expects the selected 'snapshot quota is' exception. TestSnapshotCommands#testMaxSnapshotLimit instead reaches SnapshotManager's distinct per-directory limit of 3 after the selected guard. Root has quota 0 before allowSnapshot and after disallowSnapshot, but TestSnapshot#testAllowAndDisallowSnapshot does not create a root snapshot in that state. Under unchanged workload and I/O-exception-only faults, no source-supported route changes the quota or adds ~65536 snapshots before this guard; no trial is claimed. This is a source-based feasibility assessment, not a runtime target trace.
